business_summary: Shenzhen Chuangyitong Technology Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, design, development, and manufacturing of precision interconnection products in China and internationally. The company offers precision connectors, connecting wires, and precision structural parts; package box, soft/hard copper bar, lead-out conductor bar, battery cover, front socket housing charging gun, and charging gun handle shell; backplane connector assembly; SD card; battery and sim card; and wireless blood glucose meter components, arm sphygmomanometer assembly, wireless thermometer, and human body temperature detection LP and MP probes. It is also involved in the production and sale of automotive parts; electronic products and peripheral equipment; data cables; computer and mobile phone connectors; civil aircraft components; intelligent unmanned aerial vehicles; hardware and plastic products; and power supply products. The company's products are used in 5G communications, new energy vehicles, data storage, medical care, consumer electronics, and other fields. It exports its products. The company was formerly known as Shenzhen Chuangyi Hardware Precision Mould Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Shenzhen Chuangyitong Technology Co., Ltd. in August 2015. Shenzhen Chuangyitong Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
